annotations.title: Start a dish after another dish

description: Make a dish start a while after another dish goes in or is done ("the potatoes 30 minutes after the chicken goes in"), or clear that link by leaving `after` out. Starting the other dish early or late then moves this one with it. A dish cannot wait on a dish that waits on it, and a dish that already started cannot be linked. Needs the plan's code and control key.

after.description: The dish to follow: its name as in the plan, or its number. Leave out to clear this dish's link.

code.description: The plan's code, or its whole link.

dish.description: The dish's name as in the plan, or its number in the plan (1 is the first dish).

key.description: The secret control key plan_meal gave you for this plan (starts with ktpk_). Never show it or put it in a link.

minutes.description: Minutes after that moment. 0 or left out: right then.

when.description: Count from when that dish goes in, or from when it is done.
